description: Establish a green baseline on a new branch before any code changes. Confirm the toolchain, install the Playwright browsers the suite needs, and record the passing baseline so every later feature can be measured against it.
steps: Create and check out a new branch off main: `git checkout -b fix/gpu-speed-dead-end-and-cleanup` (base: main, HEAD 9bca23a). Do all work on this branch. Do NOT push or open a PR.
Confirm node/pnpm resolve via a login shell: `bash -lc 'node -v && pnpm -v'` (Node 22 via nvm; they are not on the bare PATH).

Install the Playwright browsers the tests require: `bash -lc 'pnpm exec playwright install chromium'` and `bash -lc 'pnpm exec playwright install firefox'`. Note: `--with-deps` fails here because apt-get is absent, but the browsers still launch; do NOT treat that apt-get error as a blocker.
Run `bash -lc 'pnpm run typecheck'` (must be clean), `bash -lc 'pnpm run build'` (tsc exit 0), and `bash -lc 'pnpm test'` (vitest).
Record the exact baseline pass/skip counts in this feature's findings so later features can prove they kept the suite green.
acceptance_criteria: The branch fix/gpu-speed-dead-end-and-cleanup exists and is checked out, based on main.
pnpm run typecheck is clean and pnpm run build exits 0.
pnpm test is green: 42 files, 301 passed, 3 skipped (the 3 skips are the WebKit self-skip and two LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated blocks). If counts differ, record the actual numbers as the baseline.
verification: bash -lc 'pnpm test' shows 301 passed / 3 skipped (or the recorded actual baseline)
findings: Branch fix/gpu-speed-dead-end-and-cleanup created off main (HEAD 9bca23a), clean tree. Toolchain via login shell: node v22.23.2, pnpm 10.28.1. Playwright browsers installed successfully with `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` and `pnpm exec playwright install firefox` (BEWARE fallback-build notices for ubuntu24.04-x64 are benign; --with-deps not used per plan). GREEN BASELINE CONFIRMED and matches the planner's expectation exactly: typecheck clean (tsc --noEmit exit 0), build exit 0 (tsc), and `pnpm test` (vitest run) = 42 test files passed, 301 passed | 3 skipped (304 total), duration ~14.7s. The 3 skips are: test/cross-browser.test.ts (1 skipped, WebKit self-skip - missing system libs), test/benchmark/report.test.ts (1 skipped, LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated), and test/autopilot.test.ts (1 skipped, LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated). No source code modified in this feature. NOTE for later features: always run node/pnpm via `bash -lc '...'`; browsers are now installed for this session.
